INTERIOR ARCHITECTURE

Dramatic Verticality & Fall Protection

Secure floating steps and duplex voids without heavy glass partitions that collect smudges or obstruct natural light.

Floating Staircase Integrity

Cantilevered and open-tread stairs look visually striking but pose severe fall hazards for children. Vertical invisible cables provide transparent edge protection from step to ceiling.

Airy Spatial Continuation

Unlike solid glass panels that restrict air circulation and require frequent cleaning, tensioned cables maintain breezy open-plan airflow across multi-level duplex living rooms.

Structural Ceiling Anchors

Heavy-duty counter-sunk anchors embedded into concrete slabs with concealed aesthetic caps ensure pristine architectural alignment without visible brackets.
